scope: Static review of the four assigned artifacts only. No feature CSV/data binary read; no script execution, fit, inference, checkpoint access, or shared-state change.

blocking_issue.location: runner.py, feature loop: rate=float(f['rate20_per_cycle']) occurs before calculate(..., f['rate20_missing']=='True').
blocking_issue.reason: The protocol requires a missing-rate row to be emitted as status missing_rate with no finite RUL. If rate20_missing is True and rate20_per_cycle is blank or otherwise nonnumeric, float conversion raises before calculate can take its missing branch; the run stops instead of producing the promised per-origin explicit nonfinite status and metrics.
blocking_issue.minimal_fix: Read and validate the missing flag first. When it is True, pass a harmless placeholder or None into a missing-aware calculate signature without parsing the rate field; otherwise parse the rate and classify nonfinite values explicitly. Preserve the fixed denominator and null full-linear MAE behavior.

other_static_checks: Formula applies only when rate is finite and negative and SOH is finite and above .8; nonnegative rate, SOH<=.8, and nonfinite numeric inputs/output are assigned explicit no-finite-RUL statuses.

Per-cell full_linear metric returns null if any linear prediction is unavailable; aggregate full_linear_metrics is null unless all 4567 origins are finite. Common-finite-subset comparisons are labeled separately and do not replace full-population metrics.

Feature manifest binds ten calibration cells only, source_role train, event_cycle, prefix_count, per-file SHA, and two manifest SHAs. Runner enforces key uniqueness/alignment, visible_through_cycle==origin<event, true_RUL==event_cycle-origin, and exact coverage of the saved 4567 calibration keys.

Protocol states SOH unit QDischarge/1.1Ah, past-20 Theil-Sen rate in SOH per actual cycle, and EOL at first actual Q<=.88Ah. Static dedup receipt reports no prior named analytic baseline and no data read.

Runner verifies source hashes, coordinator owner/takeover and lock before create-only invocation claim; no fit/model/checkpoint/devtest path is present, and feature reads are capped to the ten listed calibration files.
execution_boundary: Do not issue the fresh exact GO or run until the missing-rate parsing path is corrected and this static review is repeated on the revised hash. No other scope was reviewed.
